BiblicalUsage: To become chief is what happens to Daniel: he is preferred above the presidents and princes because an excellent spirit is in him, and the king thinks to set him over the whole realm. The word is the rising itself — excellence noticed, and authority following.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe excellence is the quiet road to the top: Daniel did not push for the realm, his spirit made him first, and the king saw it.
